input.fullContext:
Prepare the checkout announcement thumbnail for approval.

Open Figma file `figma-checkout-v2`, inspect frame `hero-social`, and export that frame to `exports/checkout-hero-source.png` at 2x PNG. Open the export in Photoshop, apply brightness 8 and contrast 12, then export `exports/checkout-hero-final.png` as PNG. Post to Slack channel `C-MARKETING` with the exact text `Checkout v2 social thumbnail ready for approval`. Include the generated artifact URL in the draft body.

Do the work through MCP tools; a prose response alone does not complete the task.

Use this exact Slack message value: `Checkout v2 social thumbnail ready for approval

Artifact links:
https://artifacts.mock.invalid/checkout-hero-final.png`.
